rules.name: Unquantified adjective
rules.test: A degree adjective with no measurable threshold.

rules.name: Missing actor
rules.test: Passive construction that omits who performs the action.
rules.ask: Who performs this — which user role or which service?

rules.name: Open-ended enumeration
rules.ask: List the remaining cases, or state the rule that generates them.

rules.name: No observable outcome
rules.test: No stated way to tell, from outside, whether this holds.
rules.ask: What would you observe to confirm this shipped correctly?

rules.name: Missing failure behaviour
rules.test: Describes what happens when things work, and says nothing about what happens when a step fails, times out, or is refused.
rules.ask: What should happen when this fails — and who finds out?

rules.name: Unstated clock or time zone
rules.test: A deadline, duration or date with no stated starting point, calendar (business or calendar days) or time zone.
rules.ask: Measured from when, in which time zone, and in business or calendar days?

rules.name: Unstated data rule
rules.test: A value is captured, stored or shown with no format, limit, rounding or uniqueness rule.
rules.ask: What format, limits and rounding apply to this value, and must it be unique?

rules.name: Unstated permission
rules.test: An action with no statement of who is allowed to perform it, or what someone without permission sees.
rules.ask: Who is allowed to do this, and what does someone who is not allowed see?

rules.name: Contradiction between criteria
rules.test: Two statements in the same requirement that cannot both hold, or that give different values for the same thing.
rules.ask: These two statements disagree — which one is right?
